title: Vocabulary Quiz — Intonation Lesson 1: Places
subtitle: Words from the Lesson 1 vocabulary list (places)

words.def: quiet and calm, without noise or worry
words.sent: It’s so ___ in the park early in the morning.

words.def: quiet and not moving, with no problems
words.sent: The lake is very ___ today — there is no wind.

words.def: making a lot of loud sounds
words.sent: I can’t sleep because my street is so ___.

words.def: full of people
words.sent: The market is very ___ at the weekend.

words.def: close enough to go there on foot
words.sent: My school is ___ of my house — only ten minutes.

words.def: a long seat outside, usually in a park
words.sent: I sat on a ___ and read my book.

words.def: to walk for pleasure
words.sent: After dinner I like to ___ near the lake.

words.def: to run for exercise
words.sent: My dad likes to ___ every morning before work.

words.def: making you feel calm and not worried
words.sent: Swimming is very ___ for me after a hard week.

words.def: to stop thinking about something
words.sent: In the park I can ___ my problems for a while.

words.def: for a short time
words.sent: I sat there ___ and watched the birds.

words.def: to take air into your body and send it out again
words.sent: In the mountains it is easy to ___ — the air is clean.

words.def: clean, cool air outside
words.sent: I go out for some ___ after I study.

words.def: to leave a place or person so that you are free from it
words.sent: I go to the lake to ___ the noise of the city.

words.def: the busy, noisy activity of a lot of people
words.sent: I love the ___ of the city centre.

words.def: the feeling of a place
words.sent: The café has a friendly ___.

words.def: the natural things you see in a place, like hills and rivers
words.sent: The ___ in the mountains is beautiful.

words.def: to rest so that you have energy again
words.sent: A weekend at the beach helps me ___.

words.def: a very good place that few people know about
words.sent: This small café is a ___ — nobody knows it.

words.def: a place that you must visit
words.sent: West Lake is a ___ in Hanoi.
